name: pdf-human-review
description: Open a PDF in an interactive review page (PDF.js) with Google-Docs-style comments on selected text and boxed figures, then hand the reviewer's comments back to the calling agent as markdown.

interface.shortDescription: Review a PDF in the browser and send your comments back to the agent
interface.longDescription: Opens a PDF in a local review page. Select text or box a figure, table or equation, leave comments in the margin, and press Submit. The agent receives the comments as markdown with page numbers and quoted text.
defaultPrompt: I want to do a human review of this PDF.
